1.text: Nuko Yesu arangije ayo magambo yose abwira abigishwa be ati

2.text: “Muzi yuko iminsi ibiri nishira hazabaho Pasika, Umwana w'umuntu azagambanirwa abambwe.”

3.text: Maze abatambyi bakuru n'abakuru b'ubwo bwoko, bateranira mu rugo rw'Umutambyi mukuru witwaga Kayafa,

4.text: bagira inama hamwe yo koshyoshya Yesu ngo babone uko bamufata, bamwice.

5.text: Ariko baravuga bati “Twe kumufata mu minsi mikuru, kugira ngo bidatera abantu imidugararo.”

6.text: Yesu ari i Betaniya mu nzu ya Simoni umubembe,

7.text: umugore aza aho ari afite umukondo w'amavuta meza, ameze nk'amadahano y'igiciro cyinshi cyane, ayamusuka ku mutwe yicaye arya.

8.text: Abigishwa babibonye bararakara bati “Aya mavuta apfiriye iki ubusa,

9.text: ko yajyaga kugurwa impiya nyinshi zigafasha abakene?”

10.text: Ariko Yesu abimenye arababaza ati “Uyu mugore muramuterera iki agahinda, ko ankoreye umurimo mwiza?

11.text: Abakene muri kumwe na bo iteka, ariko jyeweho ntituri kumwe iteka.

12.text: Igitumye uyu mugore ansukaho ayo mavuta ku mubiri, ni ukuwutunganiriza guhambwa.

13.text: Ndababwira ukuri yuko aho ubutumwa bwiza buzigishirizwa hose mu isi yose, icyo uyu mugore ankoreye kizavugirwa kugira ngo bamwibuke.”

14.text: Hanyuma umwe muri abo cumi na babiri witwaga Yuda Isikariyota, asanga abatambyi bakuru

15.text: arababaza ati “Mwampa iki nkamubagenzereza?” Bamugerera ibice by'ifeza mirongo itatu,

17.text: Ku munsi wa mbere wo kurya imitsima idasembuwe, abigishwa begera Yesu baramubaza bati “Urashaka ko dutunganiriza he aho uri burīre ibya Pasika?”

18.text: Arabasubiza ati “Mujye mu murwa kwa ntuza, mumubwire muti ‘Umwigisha aravuze ngo igihe cye kirenda kugera, ngo iwawe ni ho ari busangirire ibya Pasika n'abigishwa be.’ ”

19.text: Abigishwa bagenza uko Yesu yababwiye, baringaniza ibya Pasika.

20.text: Bugorobye yicarana n'abigishwa cumi na babiri ngo basangire.

21.text: Bakirya arababwira ati “Ndababwira ukuri, yuko umwe muri mwe ari bungambanire.”

22.text: Barababara cyane, baherako bamubaza umwe umwe bati “Mwami, ni jye?”

23.text: Na we arabasubiza ati “Uwo duhuriza amaboko ku mbehe, ni we uri bungambanire.

24.text: Umwana w'umuntu aragenda nk'uko byanditswe kuri we, ariko uwo muntu ugambanira Umwana w'umuntu azabona ishyano, ibyajyaga kumubera byiza ni uko aba ataravutse.”

25.text: Yuda uwo wari ugiye kumugambanira aramubaza ati “Mwigisha, ni jye?”Aramusubiza ati “Wakabimenye.”

26.text: Bakirya Yesu yenda umutsima arawushimira, arawumanyagura, awuha abigishwa be arababwira ati “Nimwende murye, uyu ni umubiri wanjye.”

27.text: Yenda igikombe aragishimira, arakibaha, arababwira ati “Munywere kuri iki mwese,

28.text: kuko aya ari amaraso yanjye y'isezerano rishya, ava ku bwa benshi ngo bababarirwe ibyaha.

29.text: Ariko ndababwira rwose yuko ntazanywa ku mbuto z'imizabibu, mpereye none nkageza umunsi nzasangirira namwe vino nshya mu bwami bwa Data.”

30.text: Bamaze kuririmba barasohoka, bajya ku musozi wa Elayono.

31.text: Maze Yesu arababwira ati “Mwebwe mwese iri joro ibyanjye birabahemuza, kuko byanditswe ngo ‘Nzakubita umwungeri, umukumbi w'intama usandare.’

32.text: Ariko nimara kuzūrwa, nzababanziriza kujya i Galilaya.”

33.text: Maze Petero aramusubiza ati “Nubwo bose ibyawe biri bubagushe, jyeweho ntabwo bizangusha.”

34.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Ndakubwira ukuri yuko muri iri joro, inkoko itarabika uri bunyihakane gatatu.”

35.text: Petero aramubwira ati “Naho byatuma mpfana nawe, na bwo sindi bukwihakane na hato.” N'abandi bigishwa bose bavuga batyo.

36.text: Maze Yesu agerana na bo ahitwa i Getsemani, abwira abigishwa be ati “Nimube mwicaye aha nigire hariya nsenge.”

37.text: Ajyana Petero na bene Zebedayo bombi, atangira kubabara no guhagarika umutima cyane.

38.text: Maze arababwira ati “Umutima wanjye ufite agahinda kenshi kenda kunyica. Mugume hano, mubane maso nanjye.”

39.text: Yigira imbere ho hato arunama, arasenga ati “Data, niba bishoboka iki gikombe kindenge, ariko bye kuba uko jyewe nshaka, ahubwo bibe uko wowe ushaka.”

40.text: Agaruka aho abigishwa bari asanga basinziriye, abaza Petero ati “Harya ntimubashije kubana maso nanjye isaha imwe?

41.text: Mube maso, musenge mutajya mu moshya. Umutima ni wo ukunze, ariko umubiri ufite intege nke.”

42.text: Yongera kugenda ubwa kabiri arasenga ati “Data, niba bidashoboka ko iki kindenga, ngo kereka nkinywereyeho, ibyo ushaka abe ari byo biba.”

43.text: Yongeye kugaruka asanga basinziriye, kuko amaso yabo aremereye.

44.text: Arongera abasiga aho aragenda, asenga ubwa gatatu avuga amagambo amwe n'aya mbere.

45.text: Maze agaruka aho abigishwa bari arababwira ati “Musinzire noneho, muruhuke. Dore igihe kirenda gusohora, Umwana w'umuntu agambaniwe mu maboko y'abanyabyaha.

46.text: Nimubyuke tugende, dore ungenza ari hafi.”

47.text: Akibivuga, Yuda umwe muri abo cumi na babiri azana n'igitero kinini gifite inkota n'inshyimbo, giturutse ku batambyi bakuru n'abakuru b'ubwo bwoko.

48.text: Ariko umugambanira yari yabahaye ikimenyetso ati “Uwo ndi busome, ni we uwo mumufate.”

49.text: Uwo mwanya yegera Yesu aramubwira ati “Ni amahoro Mwigisha”, aramusomagura.

50.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Mugenzi wanjye, kora ikikuzanye.”Maze baraza basumira Yesu, baramufata.

51.text: Umwe muri abo bari kumwe na Yesu arambura ukuboko, akura inkota ye, ayikubita umugaragu w'Umutambyi mukuru, amuca ugutwi.

52.text: Maze Yesu aramubwira ati “Subiza inkota yawe mu rwubati rwayo, kuko abatwara inkota bose bazicwa n'inkota.

53.text: Mbese wibwira yuko ntabasha gusaba Data, akanyoherereza abamarayika nonaha basāga legiyoni cumi n'ebyiri?

54.text: Ariko rero bibaye bityo, ibyanditswe byasohora bite kandi ari ko bikwiriye kuba?”

55.text: Uwo mwanya Yesu abaza igitero ati “Harya muhurujwe no kumfata nk'uko muzira umwambuzi, mufite inkota n'inshyimbo? Nicaraga mu rusengero iminsi yose nigisha, kuki mutamfashe?

56.text: Ariko ibi byose bibereyeho kugira ngo ibyanditswe n'abahanuzi bisohore.”Nuko abigishwa bose baramuhāna, barahunga.

57.text: Abafashe Yesu bamujyana kwa Kayafa Umutambyi mukuru, ari ho abanditsi n'abakuru bari bateraniye.

58.text: Petero amukurikira arenga ahinguka agera ku rugo rw'Umutambyi mukuru, arujyamo yicarana n'abagaragu ngo arebe amaherezo.

59.text: Maze abatambyi bakuru n'abanyarukiko bose bashaka Yesu ho ibirego by'ibinyoma ngo babone uko bamwica,

60.text: barabibura nubwo haje abagabo b'ibinyoma benshi. Hanyuma haza babiri

61.text: baravuga bati “Uyu yagize ngo yabasha gusenya urusengero rw'Imana, akarwubaka mu minsi itatu.”

62.text: Umutambyi mukuru arahaguruka aramubaza ati “Ntiwiregura na hato? Ntiwumvise ibyo aba bakureze?”

63.text: Yesu aricecekera. Umutambyi mukuru aramubwira ati “Nkurahirije Imana ihoraho, tubwire niba ari wowe Kristo, Umwana w'Imana.”

64.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Wakabimenye, kandi ndababwira yuko hanyuma muzabona Umwana w'umuntu yicaye iburyo bw'ubushobozi bw'Imana, aje ku bicu byo mu ijuru.”

65.text: Umutambyi mukuru abyumvise atyo ashishimura imyenda ye ati “Arigereranije. Turacyashakira iki abagabo? Dore noneho mwiyumviye kwigereranya kwe.

67.text: Nuko bamucira amacandwe mu maso, bamukubita ibipfunsi, abandi bamukubita inshyi bati

69.text: Ubwo Petero yari yicaye hanze mu rugo, umuja aramwegera aramubwira ati “Nawe wari kumwe na Yesu w'Umunyagalilaya.”

70.text: Maze abihakanira imbere ya bose ati “Ibyo uvuze sinzi ibyo ari byo.”

71.text: Arasohoka ageze mu bikingi by'amarembo undi muja aramubona, abwira abahari ati “N'uyu yari kumwe na Yesu w'i Nazareti.”

72.text: Yongera kubihakana arahira ati “Uwo muntu simuzi.”

73.text: Hashize umwanya muto, abari bahagaze aho baraza babwira Petero bati “Ni ukuri nawe uri umwe muri bo, ndetse ni imvugo yawe irakumenyekanishije.”

74.text: Maze atangira kwivuma no kurahira ati “Uwo muntu simuzi.”Muri ako kanya inkoko irabika.

75.text: Petero yibuka ijambo Yesu yari yavuze ati “Inkoko itarabika uri bunyihakane gatatu.” Arasohoka ararira cyane.
